question: The element with atomic number 21 is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scandium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The element with atomic number 21 is **Scandium (Sc)**, a rare-earth metal and the first element in the transition metals group.
 
• Scandium has the electron configuration **[Ar] 3d¹4s²**, indicating its place in the d-block of the periodic table.
 
• It is a silvery-white metallic element that is soft and lightweight, often used in alloys to enhance strength without adding significant weight.
 
• Scandium is primarily obtained from minerals like **thortveitite** and as a by-product of uranium refining.
 
• Applications of scandium include aerospace components, sports equipment, and high-intensity lighting due to its favorable properties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calcium (Atomic number 20)**

 
 
• Calcium is an alkaline earth metal with the symbol **Ca** and an atomic number of 20.
 
• It is essential for biological processes, playing a key role in bone and teeth formation, muscle contraction, and nerve function.
 
• Calcium compounds, such as calcium carbonate, are widely used in cement, plaster, and as dietary supplements.
 
 
 
• **Titanium (Atomic number 22)**
 
 
• Titanium is a transition metal with the symbol **Ti** and an atomic number of 22.
 
• It is known for its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, corrosion resistance, and biocompatibility.
 
• Applications include aerospace structures, medical implants, and as a pigment in paints and coatings (titanium dioxide).
 
 
 
• **Zinc (Atomic number 30)**
 
 
• Zinc is a transition metal with the symbol **Zn** and an atomic number of 30.
 
• It is an essential trace element for humans, playing a vital role in enzyme function, immune response, and cell division.
 
• Zinc is widely used in galvanization to protect steel from corrosion and in the production of alloys like brass.
